response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/backend engineer with strong open-source, teaching, and infrastructure exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience (only a brief ~6-month C/C++ stint at National Instruments), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed systems leadership experience, and his career is centered on web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than cloud infrastructure or compute platforms.
strengths: Extensive polyglot engineering experience (15+ years) across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
Founder of a self-built platform (GISCollective) showing initiative and end-to-end ownership
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months), far short of the 8-year requirement
No evident experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed systems, or hardware architecture
No formal technical leadership title or track record managing cross-team priorities/deadlines at scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud/distributed systems platform experience
Broad engineering versatility and mentoring background
